mapper.select: SELECT po.id AS poId, po.po_no AS poNo, po.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, s.settle_days AS settleDays, po.audit_time AS auditTime, po.total_amount - IFNULL(pp.paid_amount, 0) AS unpaidAmount FROM purchase_order po JOIN supplier s ON s.id = po.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a.alloc_biz_id AS po_id, SUM(a.amount) AS paid_amount FROM payment_alloc a JOIN payment_record pr ON a.payment_id = pr.id WHERE a.alloc_biz_type = 'PURCHASE' AND pr.status = 'NORMAL' AND pr.deleted = 0 GROUP BY a.alloc_biz_id ) pp ON pp.po_id = po.id WHERE po.status IN ('AUDITED', 'PARTIAL_RECEIVED', 'RECEIVED', 'CLOSED') AND s.settle_days IS NOT NULL AND po.audit_time IS NOT NULL AND po.audit_time + INTERVAL s.settle_days DAY < #{asOf} AND po.total_amount - IFNULL(pp.paid_amount, 0) > 0 ORDER BY po.audit_time ASC LIMIT 500
